memory_update.text: LITE should remain a reference-lane anchor for CW lasers and external light sources in silicon photonics/CPO, but its high attention and large market cap make it less suitable for the underfollowed discovery lane.

AXTI is a high-priority underfollowed candidate for the InP substrate layer; later layers must verify true datacenter/silicon-photonics revenue contribution, customer qualification evidence, and China/raw-material risk.
VECO is a high-priority adjacent chokepoint candidate because recent InP laser equipment orders directly connect it to capacity expansion for silicon-photonics and datacom laser manufacturing.
